Summary
This resolution allows the Township Council to hold a closed session during their regular meeting on April 22, 2025, to discuss certain matters that fall under the Open Public Meetings Act (N.J.S.A. 10:4 et seq.). The council can exclude the public from discussing topics such as pending or anticipated litigation, collective bargaining agreements, and personnel matters.


Key Provisions
- Discussion of any material, the disclosure of which constitutes an invasion of individual privacy.
- A collective bargaining agreement or the terms of provisions of same.
- Techniques or tactic utilized to protect the safety and property of the public provided that their disclosure could impair such protection.

- Pending or anticipated litigation or contract negotiation in which this body is or may be a party.
- A matter falling within the attorney-client privilege to the extent that confidentiality is required in order for the attorney to exercise his ethical duties to this body.
- Personnel matters.
- Discussion of any matter which by express provision of Federal law or State statute or rule of Court shall be rendered confidential.
- Discussion of any matter in which the release of information would impair a right to receive funds from the Government of the United States.
- Discussion of any matter involving the purchase, lease or acquisition of real property with public funds, the setting of banking rates or investment of public funds, where it could adversely affect the public interest if discussion of such matters were disclosed.
- Deliberations occurring after a public hearing that may result in imposition of a civil penalty or suspension or loss of a license or permit.

Summary
This resolution allows the Township Council to hold a closed session to discuss certain matters that are exempt from public disclosure under the Open Public Meetings Act.

Key Provisions
- Discussion of any material, the disclosure of which constitutes an invasion of individual privacy.
- Collective bargaining agreement or the terms of provisions of same.
- Techniques or tactic utilized to protect the safety and property of the public provided that their disclosure could impair such protection.
- An investigation of violations or possible violations of the laws of the State of New Jersey and/or the Township of West Orange Administrative Code.
- Pending or anticipated litigation or contract negotiation in which this body is or may be a party.
- A matter falling within the attorney-client privilege to the extent that confidentiality is required in order for the attorney to exercise his ethical duties to this body.
- Personnel matters.
- Discussion of any matter which by express provision of Federal law or State statute or rule of Court shall be rendered confidential.
- Discussion of any matter in which the release of information would impair a right to receive funds from the Government of the United States.
- Discussion of any matter involving the purchase, lease or acquisition of real property with public funds, the setting of banking rates or investment of public funds, where it could adversely affect the public interest if discussion of such matters were disclosed.
- Deliberations occurring after a public hearing that may result in imposition of a civil penalty or suspension or loss of a license or permit.

- Discussion of any material, the disclosure of which constitutes an invasion of individual privacy.

- Discussion of any material, the disclosure of which constitutes an invasion of individual privacy.
